messages:
Arjun Patel: heads-up — after the AWQ pack rollout on mixtral-8b were seeing a p99 tail spike for long sequences (>=1024). repro script attached.

Sofia Ruiz: saw the spike on the perf dashboard. is this isolated to mixtral canary?

Ben Lee: only on mixtral canary pools. qwen/llama canaries look normal.

Maya Chen: quick run details:
```
model: mixtral-8b-awq-int8
kernel_selector: v2 (auto)
input: synthetic long 1500 tok, prefix caching OFF
batcher: microbatch=1 dynbatch=off
baseline p99: 380ms -> canary p99: 720ms
flame link: https://internal.flame/2481234567
```

Arjun Patel: selector log shows fallback to generic attention kernel due to a stride/head_dim detection mismatch after AWQ packing.
```
[selector] kernel=generic_attention reason=packed_stride_mismatch model=mixtral heads=32 head_dim=128 quant=awq_packed
```

Sofia Ruiz: ah — AWQ pack changes the weight layout stride. our head_dim heuristic assumes contiguous layout, so optimized rope kernel is disabled. we put a conservative tripwire earlier to avoid correctness issues.

Ben Lee: any signal on accuracy regressions from AWQ on our calibration set? we cant accept >0.5% EM drop.

Maya Chen: calibration summary (200-item dev prompts):
- AWQ-int8 naive: EM -0.7%, token-F1 -1.0%
- AWQ-int8 + per-channel calib: EM -0.2%, token-F1 -0.4%
- GPTQ-4bit baseline: EM +0.1%, token-F1 0.0%
so AWQ with per-channel calibration looks within tolerance.

Arjun Patel: so correctness OK but perf suffers due to selector conservatism. mitigation options: 1) relax stride check for mixtral-awq, 2) add model-hint table to selector, 3) revert AWQ canary for mixtral.

Sofia Ruiz: propose quick patch: allow packed-stride when head_dim % 64 == 0 OR model_hint=="mixtral". patch snippet:
```
if quant_scheme == "awq" and (head_dim % 64 == 0 or model_hint == "mixtral"):
  accept_packed_stride = True
```

Ben Lee: try selector tweak first. run a 1-hour micro-canary and run KV-cache stress (many short-turn convs) + longseq throughput with prefix-cache ON/OFF. we need to ensure cache + kernel interplay isnt amplifying latency.

infra-bot: deploy queued: canary/runtime-selector-relax-2481234567 -> scheduled on eng-runtime-canary-2 in 3m :rocket:

Maya Chen: kicked off micro-canary. baseline vs patch comparison will include p50/p95/p99, throughput, and correctness samples. also running a KV-warmup test where we cycle 5000 short convs to stress the cache eviction path.

perfbot: micro-canary 10m in: p50 stable, p95 +5%, p99 +1.3x vs baseline. longseq throughput reduced ~8%. full 1h report ETA ~50m.

Sofia Ruiz: subtlety: when selector changes kernel, prefetcher behavior changes too (different prefetch stride), which increases L2 miss rate for the KV cache on long sequences. that could explain throughput loss. we should profile hardware counters for L2 miss / bandwidth.

Arjun Patel: agree. if micro-canary p99 <1.05x and no correctness impact, we can promote. otherwise rollback AWQ for mixtral and keep others. longer-term: expand selector to a param table keyed by (model_family, quant_scheme, head_dim, packed_stride) sourced from offline profiling.

Maya Chen: continued actions:
- attach flamegraphs + hw counters when 1h finishes
- add targeted perf test: longseq with prefix-cache toggled and batcher dynbatch enabled
- generate selector model-hint CSV from profiling runs and file an Optimize ticket to ingest it

Ben Lee: thanks. once you post the final graphs well decide promote vs rollback. leave AWQ on other families for now. :thumbsup:
